name: Shendi Teuku Maulana Efendi
role: AI Engineer | Code Reviewer | Long Life Learner
about: Fresh Graduate in Informatics Engineering with strong expertise in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and Data Science. Experienced in developing end-to-end MLOps pipelines, model deployment, and intelligent data systems. Passionate about crafting AI-driven solutions that bridge data, engineering, and innovation.

experience.title: AI Engineer Intern
experience.description: Architected and deployed an end-to-end microservices pipeline on a Linux VPS using Docker Compose, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, MinIO, and Vite. Developed an agentic smart crawler with Browser Use and Playwright, powered by Qwen 3.5 4B, and a Selenium-based crawler for AMP domains. Executed Continual Pre-Training (CPT) and Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) on Qwen3-8B using LoRA and 4-bit quantization. Engineered a multimodal vision pipeline fine-tuning ViT (99% accuracy) and RT-DETR for UI element detection.

experience.title: External Code Reviewer (Freelance)
experience.description: Conducted technical audits, debugging, and code reviews for 400 to 450 projects per month across Gen AI, MLOps, Data Science, and Deep Learning paths. Evaluated Custom Training Loops, Seq2Seq, and Multi-Head Attention. Audited deployment pipelines via GitHub Actions, MLflow, DagsHub, Prometheus, and Grafana.

experience.title: AI Engineer Cohort
experience.description: Graduated with Distinction (Ranked 37th out of 616). Completed 900+ hours of intensive project-based training in AI. Developed a Gold price prediction system utilizing a GRU with a 60-day sliding window architecture achieving R² = 0.9971. Optimized using hyperopt and VADER sentiment analysis, deployed via Streamlit.

experience.title: Data Scientist Intern

Resolved extreme class imbalance via SMOTE and class-weighting, increasing Sensitivity (Recall) to ~0.89. Achieved ROC-AUC of 0.86 with 5-fold cross-validation.

experience.title: Machine Learning Engineer Intern
